Author: @ZanimationsOfficial
Content:
I’m that guy..




Friday Night Funkin’ got a big update called “PITSTOP 2” which released on March 31st, 2025, which has a LOT of new stuff like…

WEEKEND 1:

It’s kind of like week 8 but you get to play as Pico and battle someone called “Darnell” and a girl named “Nene” on the boombox and the week has 4 SONGS, which isn’t like the others. After you finish the week, you get to play as Pico with his own mixes, which leads to..

NEW FREEPLAY MENU:

This menu has LOADS of stuff, new background, album covers, and you can favorite songs, also with this, they added 2 new modes, “Erect,” and “Nightmare.” it’s not like the original mixes, they just made it harder than the original songs. Not all songs are released with a nightmare mode but it might come in a future update.

And a little thing you probably won’t care about..

NEW DEBUG MENU:

Instead of pressing 7 (or any keybind you used) on a song, just press 7 in the freeplay menu and it has 2 new editors and an updated chart editor menu! Those two new editors are “Animation Editor,” and “Stage Editor,” they also have an option to view a lag folder in the game which isn’t very useful to others.

All of these are mostly required to download the full game and not on browser.


No this isn’t AI. Also not all info is accurate but it is close to the actual game.

I forgot to say these two extra things, the game also has a way to add mods, it’s called “V-Slice Mods” which you can find on Gamebanana. With it, there is also an official mobile port of the whole game, on App Store and Google Play. It also supports V-Slice Mods, but it has to be mobile compatible, which is also on Gamebanana.

MORE DOWN HERE FOR MORE INFO
(Pls look at it, it will be very helpful)

Specific update: 
Friday night funkin is now avabile on mobile!!
You can watch the trailer on youtube.   

Game play update:
When you into the game and select “Freeplay” there is a new gameplay screen for it. Each song is displayed as normal and also each album it is placed in. If you press the right arrow you can play the erect and nightmare versions of the songs. (I want you to play these because everything else is the same lol) 

Also in the freeplay screen you can press the “Tab” key and get a special suprise!😻 Once you get there you can look around and press enter to get the surprise. (i REALLY want you to do this version) 

Lastly “Weekend” is out which you can play through the story mode. There is also a BF- mix, but you’ll figure out what this is later. (Deffo play this too) 

ORDER SUGGESTED:
“Weekend” songs
Boyfriend erect and nightmare songs 
“Special surprise” songs 

FNF FUNKADLIX MOD:
I really want you to play this mod like its such a MUST have. You definitely vibe and laugh during this mod and I’m really hopefully that you enjoy it and play it through. Plus its short. 

Now I SWEAR I’m not telling you how to make the video but if you did all the things I just suggested above in one video would be at least an hour and 30 mins, longer probably since you be goofing around when you play fnf😭. I don’t suggest doing all that because it does hurt your fingers a lot (I know cause I did play through everything in one sitting… NEVER AGAIN💔) and it will effect your gameplay like your fingers will freeze up and you wont be able to move as fast so I suggest to not do it in one sitting. But since your the shogun you probably end up doing it in one sitting and being okay or making it in parts. I honestly don’t mind one video or parts myself but all thats up to you! 

THANKS FOR READING THIS CORY HOPE THIS HELPS A TON! ❤️

Author: @Aqua_Squid_Lux
Content:
Ok, if you were to continue playing fnf, here are some mod recommendations (in no particular order) some of these can be found in game banana or game jolt.
1. VS. Whitty (legacy)-it was one of the first mods that blew up at first during fnf's years, and I feel like you missed out on the experience when this mod came out
2. Vs Hex Mod(The weekend update)- This was one of the other classics when this first blew up, and the update that came out made it a bit more difficult, so you should try it out if your up for that.
3. Vs. Tricky (the full ass mod) - This one might put you up to the test sense from what I remember. It's really challenging, but it feels rewarding once you complete it. This was also one of the classics
4. Literally every fnf mod ever ( Bob's onslaught) - This was very popular due to it's difficulty in its early stages and the update made it very sick and also very hard so yeah(if you do end up playing this one when you play the first part the ending will end abruptly. This doesn't mean you have to play it again.)
5. Vs nonsense (v1.5)- NOTE I know there's a v2, but the creator stated that he isn't happy with v2, so im recommending the newest one he made. It's one of the more goofier mods, but one that people liked.
6. Vs. Sonic.exe 3.0 (incomplete offical release) - This one I don't remember being all incomplete, but you can still play it if  I remember correctly if not play the 2.0 one instead. This one was one of the harder ones like tricky, and theres some secret songs you can get, so I recommend looking up how to get them when you complete the main stories
7.Vs. indie cross- This mod features characters from indie games, and you might recognize some familiar faces..not saying how, tho... they have a lot of secrets, so you might search up some songs on how to get them.
8. Hypno's lullaby (canceled build)- Another one that got canceled sadly, however like sonic.exe you can still enjoy the mod regardless I think.. This one is also very creepy but it's fun nonetheless I'm only recommending this cuz I like pokemon lol.
9. Friday night fever:Frenzy- This mod is kind of like fnf:neo in the sense that all of the weeks are completely reworked with new characters and bonus songs you can find with secrets.

That's all I have for know and if you guys want I'll keep updating by you guys adding stuff in the comments.

Author: @govatsu7780
Content:
2:34 So, let me explain, Cory:

In April 2021, the game was updated, bringing week 7. After that, the base game was forgotten and only survived thanks to mods created by the community. 

But on April 30, 2024, the game was finally updated, bringing Weekend 1 (which many still say is week 8, but IT IS NOT), where we play as Pico (the character from week 3). This update also included 12 songs called Er3cts Remixes, which are remixes of the original songs. 

In June 2024, the game was updated and came with a mini-update called "Pit Stop 1: Rankings". This update brought 2 new Er3cts Remixes and a results screen with different animations, ranging from L (Loss), G (Good), E (Excellent), and P (Perfect). 

In September 2024, the game received another update called "Playable Character," which allowed players to play as Pico and brought 12 new remixes, new result animations, new stages, and a new menu featuring Lotus Juice (one of the composers of the Persona games). 

In April of this year, the game was updated again with the arrival of "Pit Stop 2: Song Pack," bringing 6 new remixes and new cutscenes and animations.

And finally, in July of this year, the game finally had an official mobile version. Week 8 will likely be released next year.
